description: Convert JSON to CSV. An array of objects becomes one row per object with nested objects/arrays flattened to dotted columns (address.city, tags.0); an array of arrays is written as-is. Fields are quoted only when needed (delimiter, quotes, line breaks, leading/trailing spaces); CRLF line ends. A formula guard (on by default) prefixes cells starting with = + - @ so spreadsheets don't run them. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/csv-json/

bom.description: Start with a UTF-8 BOM so Excel reads non-English text correctly.

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a JSON file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

safe.description: Formula guard: prefix cells like =SUM(A1) with ' (default true).

text.description: The JSON (array or object) as inline text.

name: json_to_csv
title: JSON to CSV
